about: Globe-scale overview of where Panoramax street-level pictures exist, for zooms below 5 where the live grid tiles are several MB each. Each cell sums the grid layer of the Panoramax coverage tile z0/0/0 into 0.5-degree bins; the point is the picture-weighted centroid. Live Panoramax tiles replace this overview from zoom 5 up.
source: Panoramax meta-catalogue coverage tile https://api.panoramax.xyz/api/map/0/0/0.mvt (layer 'grid': nb_pictures, nb_360_pictures)
